question: Find Esophageal/GEJ trials with median follow‑up and show months by arm.

gemini.answer: This query retrieves the NCT ID, author, year, pubmed ID, and follow-up durations (overall, treatment arm, control arm) for clinical trials specifically focused on Esophageal/GEJ cancers.
